annotations.title: Ask an investor for its beneficial owners

description: Use this when the user wants an investor entity in one of their funds to disclose who owns it. Starts a request to the investor’s own team, which gets a task and an email. Returns Capital Company’s next question, or the proposed request for the user to confirm. This call sends nothing.

request.description: What the user asked for, in their own words

team.description: The team to act on, by name, only when the user belongs to more than one team; leave it out otherwise

timeZone.description: The user’s IANA time zone, such as America/New_York

name: capital_company_request_beneficial_owners
title: Ask an investor for its beneficial owners
